name: codex-usage-bubble
description: A draggable, always-on-top Windows bubble for live Codex weekly usage.

interface.shortDescription: Live weekly Codex usage on your Windows desktop.
interface.longDescription: Install and manage a draggable, always-on-top Windows bubble that reads the signed-in Codex weekly usage window locally, lowers its water level as usage runs out, blends from green through amber to red, and refreshes automatically.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my usage bubble is running.
